records.text: Natheril Raincaller is a general-goods vendor. Visitors can browse his goods, and his role is supplying ordinary merchandise.
Lyranne Feathersong is a food-and-drink vendor, supplying provisions to visitors.
Syurana is a trade-supplies vendor.

Frostmaul Giants are one of the giant kinds occupying the large valley south of the frostsaber region. Their presence threatens the frostsabers, who are allies of the night elves; Rivern Frostwind invokes that history when asking for action against the giants.

Frostmaul Preservers are a distinct kind of Frostmaul giant in the large valley south of the frostsaber region. Rivern Frostwind names them alongside the other Frostmaul Giants as a threat to the frostsabers, longstanding allies of the night elves.
A young frost saber.
A frost saber.
A frost saber huntress that can become enraged.
A frost saber pride watcher that can become enraged.
A cobalt wyrmkin, an elite dragonkin.
A cobalt scalebane, an elite dragonkin.

A Winterfall furbolg encountered around the northern Winterspring springs. Donova Snowden describes the Winterfall as protective of the water and unwilling to let her approach; this ursa also uses Winterfall Firewater while out of combat.

A Winterfall shaman among the furbolg near the northern Winterspring springs. Donova Snowden describes the Winterfall as protective of the water and unwilling to let her approach. This shaman fights with Lightning Bolt.

A Winterfall den watcher encountered around the northern Winterspring springs. Donova Snowden describes the Winterfall as protective of the water and unwilling to let her approach; this watcher uses Winterfall Firewater while out of combat.

A Winterfall pathfinder encountered around the northern Winterspring springs. Donova Snowden describes the Winterfall as protective of the water and unwilling to let her approach. This pathfinder uses a bow in combat.
Shardtooth Bear is a bear creature in Winterspring. It casts Tendon Rip in combat.
Elder Shardtooth is an elder-named Shardtooth bear in Winterspring. It uses Demoralizing Roar in combat.
Rabid Shardtooth is a Shardtooth bear in Winterspring. It casts Rabies in combat.
Fledgling Chillwind is a young-named Chillwind creature in Winterspring.
Chillwind Chimaera is a chimaera creature in Winterspring.

Ragged Owlbeasts are wildkin found in Winterspring, according to Trull Failbane, who places them south of the road. He describes wildkin as beasts thought to guard Night elf secrets and seeks to clear the owlbeasts to gain access to the land.

A wildkin found in central Winterspring, the Raging Owlbeast is one of the creatures Trull Failbane wants driven from the region. Trull reports that Winterspring’s wildkin guard secrets connected to the night elves, though his description does not establish what this owlbeast knows or protects. It becomes enraged in combat.
The Crazed Owlbeast is a wildkin of Winterspring and one of the creatures Trull Failbane asks hunters to kill. It can display enrage when badly wounded.

A Moontouched Owlbeast is a wildkin of northern Winterspring, where Trull Failbane describes its kind as especially ferocious. Its combat behavior includes Moonfire and Rejuvenation. Trull’s account places these creatures in an area he wants explored, but does not establish that they understand or guard the secrets he suspects are there.

Berserk Owlbeasts inhabit the area around small caves in southern Winterspring. Trull Failbane suspects the wildkin there guard something valuable, and says these creatures seem to have gone mad from exposure to what they protect; that is his theory, not confirmed knowledge about their motives. They are more dangerous than the earlier types he describes, and use a combat spell.
The Winterspring Owl is a creature found across several areas of Winterspring.
The Winterspring Screecher is a beast found in several areas of Winterspring.
Rogue Ice Thistle is a beast found in Winterspring.
The Ice Thistle Yeti is a beast found in Winterspring.
The Ice Thistle Matriarch is a beast found in Winterspring.
The Ice Thistle Patriarch is a beast found in Winterspring.
A Hederine Initiate is a humanoid found in Winterspring.
A Hederine Manastalker is a humanoid found in Winterspring.
A Hederine Slayer is a demon encountered in Winterspring.
A Suffering Highborne is one of the Highborne found in Winterspring.
An Anguished Highborne is one of the Highborne found in Winterspring.

Umbranse is a human medium and mortal ally of Itharius who speaks for the dead. Itharius seeks his help to reach Eranikus through a gem, though Eranikus is not truly dead. Umbranse offers his skill at death-speaking, but old age limits him; his potent augury device has been taken against his will, and he says it must be recovered before they can help Eranikus.

Donova Snowden investigates the strange qualities of Winterspring's hot springs and suspects the demons in Darkwhisper Gorge are affecting the land. Winterfall furbolgs have obstructed her studies, but she is determined to keep observing the springs. She can temper Linken's sword and directs those seeking a Videre Elixir toward Gregan Brewspewer, whom she says can help.
Auctioneer Grizzlin provides auction services.
General Colbatann casts spells when attacked and during combat.
Mezzir the Howler is a rare-elite beast, known by this personal name and epithet.
Kashoch the Reaver is an elite undead who wields a spell in battle.
Grizzle Snowpaw is a rare-elite beast. He uses Winterfall Firewater after respawning and fights with Maul and Frost Shock.
Lady Hederine is an elite demon who fights with a spell.
Azurous is an elite dragonkin, protected against arcane damage and able to breathe frost in combat.

Ranshalla is an investigator of Winterspring’s wildkin, sent by Erelas Ambersky after exploring Kel’Theril. She believes the wildkin guard the ridge for a reason and approaches the priestesses peacefully. To investigate further, she has transcribed incantations from Kel’Theril and leads an attempt to reactivate the Altar of Elune, asking for help with its torches while she reads the words.

Jaron Stoneshaper belongs to the Explorers’ League and hunts magical artifacts in Winterspring, where he expects many are guarded. After wildkin drove him from his camp, he asks for his supplies and the amulet he unearthed to be recovered; its fierce defense by the wildkin leaves him wondering what makes it important. He has recently visited Kel’Theril and offers an eyewitness account of its history, while acknowledging he is no historian.

Storm Shadowhoof sets a series of demanding hunting trials around Winterspring, testing a hunter’s skill against formidable creatures. He judges progress closely, first withholding praise, then acknowledging the hunter’s ability and growth. After the trials, he sends the hunter to his friend Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff with a marker commemorating the accomplishments.

Umi Rumplesnicker is an inventive engineer with an ambitious sense of humor. She builds a mechanical yeti to surprise friends who have doubted her ideas, enlisting help to gather materials and deliver the prank. Pleased by its success, she offers to teach the design so others can make their own. Her lively talk mixes invention with playful confidence.

Witch Doctor Mau'ari is a practiced charm-maker whose work draws on the E'ko found in the world. She explains that carrying her Cache of Mau'ari lets certain creatures yield E'ko, and offers to transform E'ko into charms. Her Frostmaul Shard charm is made on request, and she describes its use as bringing luck.

Gregor Greystone serves as the Argent Dawn's representative to Everlook's local governance and sends progress reports to Dawn officers in the Plaguelands. He also passes along a work by the recluse medium Umbranse for Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff, whom he praises as a brilliant linguist; Gregor himself dismisses Umbranse's writing as jibber-jabber.

Felnok Steelspring is Tinkee Steamboil’s engineering colleague. He makes components for her experiment to freeze and preserve dragon whelp eggs, gathers cold-rich chillwind horns for her order, and prepares the finished package for transport to Tinkee.

Rivern Frostwind trains the feral frostsabers of Winterspring as mounts, and says riders must earn acceptance from both him and the sabers. He feeds the cats and seeks to protect them from Winterfall furbolg and Frostmaul giants; he recounts their ancient alliance with the night elves.
Glacier is identified as Rivern’s Guardian, a creature in Icecrown.

Malyfous Darkhammer is a Thorium Brotherhood specialist whose catalogue offers commissions for exceptional armor and hides. He speaks of the Brotherhood with proud severity, dismissing those he considers beneath it, and has little patience for incomplete orders.
A Cobalt Whelp is a dragon in Winterspring that casts a spell in combat.
A Cobalt Broodling is a young dragon in Winterspring that casts a spell in combat.
Spell Eaters are dragons in Winterspring that cast a spell in combat.
Spellmaw is a dragon in Winterspring. In combat it casts Frost Breath and Devour Magic, and it can gain Damage Immunity: Arcane.
Manaclaw is a dragon in Winterspring. It casts Frost Breath in combat and can gain Damage Immunity: Arcane.
Scryer is a dragon in Winterspring that casts Frost Breath in combat.

A remorseful Highborne spirit regrets the Crystal of Zin-Malor’s past harm and seeks peace for the Highborne spirits bound by its curse. The spirit speaks sorrowfully of an unchangeable past and of the crystal being whole again; its pleas address the spirits directly.

High Chief Winterfall leads the Winterfall furbolg. Donova Snowden suspects he ordered the tribe’s changed behavior after its members began ingesting a strange substance, and considers his defeat a way to stop the harm from worsening. This is Donova’s suspicion, not confirmed knowledge of his orders.

Ursius is a named Shardtooth bear in the snowy mountains northwest of Everlook. Storm Shadowhoof describes him as an agile, clever hunter who turns the tables on those pursuing him, and warns would-be hunters to stay alert.
Winterfall Runner is a level 56–57 humanoid in Winterspring. On respawning, it casts a spell.

Lorax is a satyr who paces and talks to himself. He makes a bargain over Goraluk Anvilcrack’s soul, sending you to claim it along with a stolen breastplate in exchange for teaching what Goraluk was meant to learn. Lorax treats the pact as settled when the soul is taken.

Haleh is the Blue Flight’s matron protectorate in Mazthoril. She says the flight is constrained by the Aspects’ edict to stay out of mortal affairs, but Nefarian’s threat makes intervention necessary. She can empower you to oppose his brood and direct you to Jeziba in Andorhal; her magic can also replace a lost Drakefire Amulet.

Legacki is an Everlook resident who reacts dramatically when Umi's mechanical yeti is used to prank them. They recognize Umi as the prankster behind repeated jokes and complain that she has drawn the visitor into one too.

Wynd Nightchaser welcomes travelers to Starfall Village and is connected to its local stories. He recounts the tragedy of Kel'Theril and advises that the recovered Crystal of Zin-Malor should go to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm, since it must not fall into abusive hands. He recognizes visitors sent by Ivy Leafrunner and Daryn Lightwind.
Innkeeper Vizzie welcomes guests to her inn in Everlook, offers lodging and goods, and has a dry warning about keeping clear of the stove, which she says has not exploded yet that day.
Azzleby is a stable master who offers pet stabling and help recovering lost companions.
Maethrya is a hippogryph master with a flight service for travelers seeking to travel fast.
Yugrek is a wind rider master whose flight service asks where a traveler would like to fly.
Nixxrak is a heavy armor merchant who offers goods for browsing.
Blixxrak is a light armor merchant who offers goods for browsing.
Wixxrak is a weaponsmith and gunsmith who offers goods for browsing and repair services.
Xizzer Fizzbolt keeps engineering supplies. Xizzer is one of local specialist merchants, with goods to browse for customers looking for engineering stock.
Lunnix Sprocketslip deals in mining supplies. As one of local specialist merchants, Lunnix offers a distinct stock category for customers seeking mining goods.
Himmik handles Everlook’s food and drink trade. The stock makes Himmik the town’s refreshment merchant, distinct from its suppliers of engineering, mining, alchemy, and general trade goods.
Evie Whirlbrew supplies alchemy goods. Evie’s specialist stock gives local alchemists a dedicated merchant, alongside its suppliers of engineering, mining, food, and general trade goods.
Qia is a trade-supplies merchant, with general goods for customers browsing local shops. Qia’s stock serves a broader trade role than the specialist engineering, mining, and alchemy suppliers.

Everlook’s bruisers guard the town and respond forcefully to trouble. Their warnings invoke Everlook’s neutral ground and order bloodshed offenders out; they threaten miscreants and use nets in combat to stop opponents.

Lilith the Lithe is a blunt blacksmith who warns that she might fumble and strike someone with her hammer. She seeks the Crimson Hammersmith’s apron from Stratholme and offers to teach the craft of an enchanted battlehammer in return.

Kilram calls himself master of the axe. Vosh'gajin left him a scar, and he speaks of vengeance against the shadow huntress. He seeks her snakestone from Blackrock Spire and offers to teach the craft of Dawn's Edge.

Seril Scourgebane is short with visitors and threatens to cut them in half. He says the Black Guard stole plans for Corruption and seeks proof that its swordsmith has been defeated; in return, he offers to teach the craft of a blazing rapier.
Jack Sterling, a humanoid in Winterspring.

Salfa speaks for and defends the Timbermaw at Winterspring’s entrance. She describes the Winterfall as former allies who turned hostile under their chief’s influence, threatening her tribe. She seeks help against their corruption and uses returned spirit beads to build trust, promising to speak for helpers among her people. She says the Timbermaw have few allies and need aid.

Jessica Redpath fled Lordaeron before the Scourge devastated her homeland. She fears her family died in the battle of Darrowshire and misses her younger sister, Pamela. She asks for help finding Pamela in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Chal Fairwind is identified as a Wintersaber Trainer in Winterspring.
Sar Browneye is a named individual found in Winterspring.
Rilan Howard is a named individual found in Winterspring.
Gogo is a named individual found in Winterspring.

Meggi Peppinrocker takes pride in her time in the Winterspring wilderness, though her anecdote wanders before returning to trouble there. She directs the listener to Donova Snowden for more information.

Harlo Wigglesworth shares leads from his travels: he met the unusual Winna Hazzard in Felwood, is curious about the wildkin attack near Starfall, and recommends Witch Doctor Mau’ari’s lucky charm, which he keeps for himself.
Umaron Stragarelm is a named individual found in Winterspring.
Grum Redbeard is a named individual found in Winterspring.
Izzy Coppergrab is a banker in Winterspring who provides access to a bank.
Earthcaller Franzahl studies the known and unknown elements of the world. He is asked whether he is the Earthshaper capable of creating Elementium.

Princess Tempestria is a hostile elemental challenger who declares the frozen land a starting point, taunts mortals she considers craven, and threatens that they will pay when she returns from the depths.
A summoned Watery Invader moves about at random, attacks with Frost Shock, and despawns when out of combat.

Artorius the Amiable presents himself as a friendly traveler in a remote region and invites company to keep warm. He is confronted as Artorius the Doombringer, a demon, revealing a concealed adversarial identity beneath the amiable approach.

Zap Farflinger is an unbalanced goblin engineer pursuing great wealth with a dimensional imploder he has just completed. He needs a skilled Goblin Engineer to build a dimensional ripper for testing, and says goblin engineers laugh at danger.

Elder Stonespire is a revered elder whose words look back on a time when the hunt was pursued for glory and honor, then ask whether life has changed so much. The homage offered to him is met with a promise of a token in return, while his questions about other elders place him among a wider circle of respected figures.

Elder Brightspear is a contemplative elder who reads meaning in the stars. His words describe the stars taking new paths as beacons of hope and strength for ages to come, and his questions about other elders place him within a wider circle of respected figures.

Vi'el is a demon who trades exotic reagents and complains that sales have slowed. The demon jokes about a jailer or minion outside, claims to know customers' true names, and urges them to buy expensive wares. Vi'el deals in rods and runes, is compelled to buy customers' junk, refuses armor repairs, and threatens to summon a warlock against anyone who will not move along.

Bronn Fitzwrench is a brisk goblin who says Winterspring's cold leaves newcomers from other cities needing warmth. He offers to put in a good word for people who bring runecloth and coal, describing this as a way to regain the goblins' good graces; he warns that their enemies will resent the help. His greeting asks visitors to make their business quick.

The Winterspring Flame Warden speaks for the Alliance festival fire, inviting visitors to honor it and urging them to desecrate Horde fires. This role centers on the seasonal flame and its Alliance allegiance.

The Winterspring Flame Keeper speaks for the Horde festival fire, inviting visitors to honor it and urging them to desecrate Alliance fires. This role centers on the seasonal flame and its Horde allegiance.
Crown Sprinklers are targets of an investigation in Winterspring, east of Everlook. Detective Snap Snagglebolt’s instructions call for killing them and destroying a chemical wagon.

place_records.text: You are in Winterspring, a snowbound land on Kalimdor that neither the Alliance nor the Horde holds. Everlook is its settlement, and the Timbermaw furbolgs guard a hold at its entrance. Winterfall furbolgs, owlbeasts and shardtooth bears roam the wilds, and frostmaul giants hold the large valley to the south. Cobalt dragonkin are a danger around Mazthoril.

You are in Frostsaber Rock in Winterspring, where Rivern Frostwind trains feral frostsabers as mounts and says riders must earn the acceptance of both him and the cats. Frostsaber stalkers and huntresses prowl the rock, and Winterfall furbolgs and Frostmaul giants threaten the trained cats. A spirit healer and a vendor are also here.
You are in Timbermaw Post in Winterspring. Winterfall den watchers and pathfinders roam here, along with shardtooth bears, chillwind fledglings and ragged owlbeasts.

You are in Winterfall Village in Winterspring, home of the Winterfall furbolgs who have turned hostile to the Timbermaw. Winterfall ursa and shamans are the main danger, with shardtooth maulers and chillwind chimaera close behind. Winterspring owls are found here too.

You are in Mazthoril in Winterspring, where Haleh is the matron protectorate of the Blue Flight. Haleh says the flight is bound by the Aspects' edict to stay out of mortal affairs, but Nefarian's threat makes intervention necessary. Cobalt broodlings, wyrmkin and mageweavers are the danger here, and spell eaters prowl too.

You are in Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring, where Donova Snowden investigates the strange qualities of the springs. Winterfall pathfinders and den watchers guard the water, and shardtooth bears and ragged owlbeasts roam the surrounding ground.

You are in Ice Thistle Hills in Winterspring, where ice thistle yetis are the main danger. Chillwind chimaera, shardtooth maulers and the ice thistle matriarch and patriarch are also here, and Winterspring owls are found here too.
You are in Dun Mandarr in Winterspring, where crazed, moontouched and berserk owlbeasts roam beside an elder shardtooth. Winterspring screechers are found here too.

You are in Frostwhisper Gorge in Winterspring, where Lorax the satyr paces and talks to himself, and makes deals only with mortals he considers worth his time. Frostmaul giants and preservers and a rabid shardtooth are the danger here. Winterspring screechers are found too.

You are in Owl Wing Thicket in Winterspring, a ridge that Ranshalla, an Alliance investigator of the wildkin, believes the wildkin guard for a reason. Moontouched and crazed owlbeasts prowl the thicket, and there is a spirit healer here.

You are in Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring, a frozen lake beside the ruins of Kel'Theril. Suffering and anguished highborne spirits haunt the lake, and shardtooth maulers, shardtooth bears, ragged owlbeasts and fledgling chillwinds roam around it. Winterspring owls are also found here.

You are in the Ruins of Kel'Theril in Winterspring, where cursed highborne spirits linger. A remorseful highborne spirit here regrets the harm the Crystal of Zin-Malor caused. Suffering and anguished highborne spirits and shardtooth maulers are the danger.

You are in Starfall Village in Winterspring, where Alliance folk gather. Wynd Nightchaser welcomes travelers and tells the local tale of Kel'Theril, and Jaron Stoneshaper of the Explorers' League hunts magical artifacts here. Its vendors sell general goods, food and drink, and trade supplies. Ice thistle yetis and a frostsaber are the danger nearby.

You are in Everlook, a settlement in Winterspring that neither the Alliance nor the Horde holds. It has an auction house, a bank, a flight master, an inn, repairs, a stable master, a spirit healer and vendors. The Argent Dawn and the Thorium Brotherhood both keep people here, and Storm Shadowhoof tests hunters with demanding trials against the formidable beasts of the wilds around town. Raging owlbeasts and shardtooth maulers roam nearby.

You are in Darkwhisper Gorge, a gorge in Winterspring. Vi'el, a demon, trades exotic reagents here and complains that sales have slowed, and Earthcaller Franzahl studies the elements of the world. Hederine manastalkers, initiates and slayers, along with rabid shardtooths, roam the gorge. A spirit healer and a vendor are here.
